overview: From 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-18, ethereum-optimism/optimism had 2 new PRs (0 merged), 0 new issues, and 9 active contributors.

topPRs.title: kona-node: reject malformed admin unsafe payloads
topPRs.author: joshklop
topPRs.body:
Kona's `admin_postUnsafePayload` now rejects envelopes with a mismatched block hash synchronously with `InvalidParams`, matching op-node, while valid payloads retain asynchronous queue-admission semantics. Shared acceptance coverage exercises CL rejection, EL rejection and subsequent valid CL/EL advancement.

Closes #22250. Consolidates the selected changes from #23227 and #22307 directly on `develop`, without their former stack dependencies. The first commit records the approved refactor plan; subsequent commits implement and validate this first review unit.

Validation: RPC tests (3/3), full Rust lint and Go lint pass. All six acceptance cases pass across kona-node/op-reth and op-node/op-reth, with no skips. Separate Rust and Go reviews found no actionable issues. The committed plan records the commands and the local logging setup.

topPRs.title: docs: establish code simplicity principles for agents
topPRs.author: joshklop
topPRs.body:
Agents have component-specific instructions but no shared standard for reducing code complexity. These principles provide review criteria across the monorepo through root `AGENTS.md` and its existing `CLAUDE.md` symlink, with direct attribution to matklad's [Push Ifs Up And Fors Down](https://matklad.github.io/2023/11/15/push-ifs-up-and-fors-down.html).

Documentation only, with no runtime or operator-facing changes. Two independent documentation reviews found no issues; whitespace, title format, attribution and instruction-entry-point checks pass.
